profile.name: sairamsrujan
profile.tagline: Building useful things. Exploring how they work.
profile.welcome: Welcome to my little corner of the internet. I build projects around machine learning, document intelligence, and software that makes complex information easier to explore.
about: My public work explores a common question: how can we make intelligent software more useful, understandable, and trustworthy?

From answers grounded in GitHub history to active-learning annotation tools, I enjoy turning technical ideas into working applications. Take a look around — every project here links to its source code.

projects.name: PatchContext
projects.description: RAG over the fastapi/fastapi development history with verified citations and a hallucination guard

projects.name: RepoMind
projects.description: Ask any public GitHub repository why it evolved the way it did. Answers are grounded in real commits, PRs, issues and reviews, carry inline citations to the exact GitHub page, and are verified by a two-stage guard that declines rather than guessing.

projects.name: LabelForge
projects.description: Active-learning data annotation platform — FastAPI + Next.js, offline CPU ML (YOLOv8n ONNX + zero-shot NLI), trust-weighted consensus, kappa quality reports, measured experiments

projects.name: GraphGuard
projects.description: Graph ML fraud detection benchmarked honestly under temporal distribution shift — drift-triggered retraining, three explainability methods, and an inductive scoring API.

projects.name: Papers, Explained
projects.description: Fifty-five landmark AI papers — checksummed, explained, and drawn as a wall of spines. Every figure rebuilt from the source PDF, every number traceable. Live: https://sairamsrujan.github.io/papers-explained/

projects.name: DocuMind AI
projects.description: Offline document intelligence system — Classification, Entity Extraction, RAG Q&A
